about: Size limits of the built UI in bytes, gzip-compressed (scripts/bundle-budget.mjs; npm run budget after npm run build, and in CI).
Measured on 2026-11-02 with about 10 % room: the first page load 258 kB, the English and German catalogs 116 and 129 kB, the largest other chunk 97 kB, all files 2.46 MB.
Raise a limit only in the pull request that needs it, and say why there.
Total raised to 2.8 MB with the alerting pages (M7, #287): six lazy pages, the rule editor and their catalogs add about 32 kB gzip.
